note: Open GameMapID rows for which the current official game resources provide no authoritative Game->Resource evidence. `entries` is the OPEN set: an entry here is a recorded open question, not a resolution. Production may only use one of these rows after an explicit human confirmation is stored through `QQSpeedMapCatalog.ps1 -Mode UserBinding -UserBindingAction confirm`. As of the Map Identity Closure milestone the open set is empty: the three rows that used to be listed are resolved by the resource-declared identity (`Map\Common Map\MapNN\LapDistanceFile.luc` field `mapId`), which is an official structural statement and needs neither a name join nor the +100 offset. Their closure is recorded under `closed_entries` for traceability.
policy: authoritative routes are exactly: a verified anchor, a resource-declared game MapID (MapNN LapDistanceFile.luc mapId), a unique exact official name match, or an explicit user confirmation
a near/prefix name match never promotes
the observed game_map_id = resource_map_id + 100 relation is diagnostic evidence only and is recorded as a non-authoritative offset_supported_candidate; it is not universal
a game MapID declared by two resource folders is a conflict and fails closed as ambiguous_declared_map_id
trajectory, reference line and replay geometry are never map authority
